newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Istrabenz to list shares on OTC on Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Istrabenz to list shares on OTC on Feb 3.

text.p: Petrol trading company Istrabenz will list its shares on the over-the-counter market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on February 3, the Ljubljana bourse said on Tuesday.
Istrabenz is the Slovenian partner of Austria's oil and energy group OMV AG.
Istrabenz will list 4.5 million shares, representing 87.05 percent of its equity.
The shares have a nominal value of 1,000 tolars ($6.7) each.
Istrabenz joins a batch of 25 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main and OTC markets of the Ljubljana bourse since January 1996.
Currently, there are 25 shares traded on the main market and 29 shares on the OTC market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange.
